description: This file defines the ImageClassification class in the ImageAI library, providing support for image classification using multiple deep learning models such as ResNet50, MobileNetV2, DenseNet121, and InceptionV3. It includes methods for setting model paths, selecting model types, loading models, and classifying images from various input types.

classes.name: ImageClassification
classes.description: A class for performing image classification using multiple deep learning models, supporting model setup, loading, and prediction from various input types.

methods.name: setModelPath
methods.description: Sets the file path to the model weights, required before loading the model.

methods.name: setModelTypeAsSqueezeNet
methods.description: Raises an error indicating SqueezeNet is no longer supported.

methods.name: setModelTypeAsMobileNetV2
methods.description: Sets the model type to MobileNetV2 for classification.

methods.name: setModelTypeAsResNet
methods.description: Deprecated method that redirects to setModelTypeAsResNet50.

methods.name: setModelTypeAsResNet50
methods.description: Sets the model type to ResNet50 for classification.

methods.name: setModelTypeAsDenseNet
methods.description: Deprecated method that redirects to setModelTypeAsDenseNet121.

methods.name: setModelTypeAsDenseNet121
methods.description: Sets the model type to DenseNet121 for classification.

methods.name: setModelTypeAsInceptionV3
methods.description: Sets the model type to InceptionV3 for classification.

methods.name: loadModel
methods.description: Loads the selected model architecture and weights from the specified path, with optional speed settings.

methods.name: classifyImage
methods.description: Classifies an input image (file, array, or stream) and returns the top predictions with probabilities.
